title: Upcoming Events + UE5 Update | COPI Cafe Episode 32 | Cornucopias
description:
Cardano Summit, Crypto AM Conference, Unreal Engine 5.1 and More!

In this episode of COPICafe Josh and Rob discuss the FTX situation and assure the community that Cornucopias has no exposure to it. The guys review some of the recent art create by the community. Be on the watch for a new game video during the Cardano Summit. Rob and a few other team members are heading to London for the Crypto AM Conference. They share a few leaks and discuss the the impact of the new Unreal Engine release. The episode ends with Rob and Josh discussing the upcoming soccer... I'm sorry... football match coming up next week between England and the USA teams in the World Cup.

00:00 - Introduction
00:32 - Beverage Choices
02:05 - Zero FTX Exposure
06:45 - Community Art
09:06 - Cardano Summit
12:18 - Crypto AM Conference
17:11 - LEAK
20:09 - Sector Testing
22:06 - LEAK
22:26 - Mega Domes
23:41 - Unreal Engine 5.1
27:24 - World Cup - USA v England

Post your contest entries for this episode into the "Word Game" channel in Discord. 

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
